notes.title: DashBored Map Update Patch Notes!
notes.content: [p][b]Woah, it's been a while.[/b][/p][p]There was a time where I just never stopped updating DashBored, adding new things, but it has now been over four years since the last big update to DB, and I thought it was time to do a little cleaning up here and there. Since a lot of people are discovering DashBored for the first time, I wanted to add something to help new players get into the world of the Garden of Vurrus more easily.[/p][p][/p][p]This little update adds a few tune ups to old things, as well as some nice new features![/p][p]The most major new feature is the addition of a world map![/p][h2]World Map[/h2][p]This map is accessible from the game's pause menu, and will show your location in the Garden, the location of your next objective, and a few other goodies as well. I hope this will help to prevent new players from potentially getting lost and overwhelmed in the world of the Garden.[/p][p]Here's a look at it![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/2365e54ae6a417a2e9583cf7656a7631861e9b4b.png"][/img][/p][p]The map updates in real time, and is accessible at any time![/p][p][/p][h2]Vurrus[/h2][p]Various graphics that have been left alone for a long time have gotten overhauled finally! [/p][p]This includes all of Vurrus' graphics, including their face sprites, battle sprites, and overworld graphics![/p][p]I haven't been happy with Vurrus' appearance for a long time, so I'm happy to finally do this![/p][p]Take a look at the difference of Before (top) and After (bottom)![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/ec3bd1b3d29150ad90784df2de909424edbc8d95.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Memorial to Sketchy[/h2][p]This year, one of my best friends who I have ever met, Becca, passed away to Liver Cancer. It has been incredibly hard without her, she has been one of the people who has kept me going throughout these years, and one of the people who has kept me inspired to create all this time. I miss her very much. Becca loved DashBored and its characters, especially Isaac, and I have added a small memorial area to her in the city of Roke. I may add to it more as time passes.[/p][p]I hope you are doing well Becca, wherever you are. I miss you. Rest well.[/p][p][/p][p]Other Changes:[/p][list][*][p]Improved some battle animations[/p][/*][*][p]Graphical improvements to the Corrupted Underground Village[/p][/*][*][p]New Final Nash encounter music[/p][/*][*][p]Player no longer needs to go and find the Mayor of Roke to enter the subway, hopefully removing some tedium from Day 2[/p][/*][*][p]Redid various miscellaneous NPC graphics[/p][/*][*][p]Nic no longer blushes at the thought of a horrible underwater monster[/p][/*][*][p]Redid Temprocal and Damicelle intro designs[/p][/*][*][p]Made Cute Bomb more powerful[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I thank you all for playing DashBored all of these years, and I hope that these changes will help to make the game more enjoyable and fun for both the returning and new players alike![/p][p]Have a great weekend![/p][p]-Karb[/p]

notes.title: DREAMWILD! A New Game from Fading Club!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2168450/DREAMWILD/][b]Introducing DREAMWILD! A Brand New Game from Fading Club![/b][/url]
Hello everybody! I hope you are all doing well!
I'm excited and happy to announce a brand new game from Fading Club Games!
[i]DREAMWILD[/i] is a strange, fast paced first person action game taking place in a unique, psychedelic world!
Play as a Golden Knight, thrust into a bizarre series of realms, surrounded by even more bizarre entities!
Travel deeper into the Dream Wilds, and discover the cause of the dark plague that infests the lands!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/0e6485bf9364635fa5973e186e635116a06c8619.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=tXD5B-kilr4;full][/previewyoutube]
Enter a world split between full 3D gameplay and 2D prerendered exploration!
DREAMWILD will be available this Halloween!


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2168450/DREAMWILD/]Check out DreamWild Here![/url]



[h3]An update on the Status of DashBored 2: Mechana[/h3]
I believe that transparency is important when it comes to game development.
It is with that note that I have a bit of mixed news when it comes to the Sequel to DashBored: Mechana.
Unfortunately, around a year ago, it became clear that the Engine Mechana was being developed on was simply not going to cut it. Though it ran well on my PC, any standard PC would run that Engine at a solid 7 FPS. This is simply not acceptable in my book. Along with my inexperience with 3D games development, it contributed to a slow and arduous development process which would not have resulted in a satisfactory game. 
It was not an easy decision, but I have made the decision to switch development on DashBored 2 to a new engine, Unity. Unity's development process is far faster, and leads to a far more performant game than the previous engine. However, this didn't cover my own inexperience with 3D development. That is what DREAMWILD has been for, to learn the tools necessary to build a full scale 3D game. With DREAMWILD, I have become so much faster and skilled in 3D, I can easily outpace my previous output. 
This isn't to say that the entire game of Mechana has been scrapped. The graphical assets, Soundtrack (of over 70 tracks currently), story, and certain mechanics will carry over. This, along with my new skills in developing in a 3D environment, I believe will allow for a development which is both more efficient, and leads to a much better game.
Mechana is still in heavy development, just in a new engine, which will allow for MUCH more powerful and unique gameplay.
I promise that I am working hard to make the best games that I can, and Mechana is no exception.
Look forward to more updates on DB2: Mechana in the near future, I'm very excited to show off what I have got!
In the meantime, please check out DREAMWILD, I think that any fan of DashBored will find it to be a unique and fun adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/913c26f09f80478e04cdcf0e76e26d53ba514c56.png[/img]
Thanks for everything,
-Karbonic

notes.title: DashBored: Crystal Clear! Update Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/9a77c3c8e977c85a173a65fb56135ca0d33ae6f1.png[/img]
[h1]A Brand New Update is now available for DashBored![/h1]

This update is mainly an improvement update, meaning that it seeks to clean up and update a lot of old content in DashBored. Even so, [i]a LOT [/i] has changed. Let's take a look!


[h2]Improved Face Sprites![/h2]
Though the Face Sprites have been slowly changed over the years, many of them have remained old and unedited. A lot of them were rather ugly looking. Now, many characters have had their faces updated to be both more expressive, and more on-model! Take a look! Almost all of the main characters have been affected in some way, as well as many of the background characters as well!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/546f522f3474182fa630cc577a61b341f32576af.png[/img]

[h2]Improved Battle Backgrounds![/h2]
Every single old Battle Background has been remade to fit the resolution of the game properly! If I do say myself, it makes a [b]big[/b] difference in how battles look.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/d07a30481f4452eca6e52a4fbf088a84e25f0fb1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/f9749d2e7ef0143ab8d53212287807947bcd4cf3.png[/img]

[h2]Improved Dialogue![/h2]
A lot of old dialogue was somewhat stale and outdated, now, many important scenes have been totally overhauled to be more lore-friendly and less sloppy. I hope you'll enjoy checking out these improved scenes!

[h2]Improved Overworld Sprites![/h2]
Even More Characters' overworld Sprites have been improved or totally redone!
Some Characters that have redone include:
[list]
[*]Eloise
[*]Lord Occidere
[*]Doch Sneg
[*]Madame Lochhart
[*]Rhassago
[*]Final Boss
[*]Old Men NPCs
[/list]
And a lot more! Have fun checking out these characters in a new crystal clear vision!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/9808624f6701d3de7a6dc900c42df3d88a972394.png[/img]

[h2]Brand New Music![/h2]
A whole collection of new and improved music has been added! Areas with new music include:
[list]
[*]Night Meeting with Midori
[*]Russian Hideout
[*]Undersyde
[*]M&J area
[*]Precipice
[*]While Driving
[*]New Boss Music
[*]New Special Enemy Music
[/list]
And more on top of that!

[h2]Improved Area Graphics![/h2]
A few places have had their tilesets improved, but most notably Gourdemoore and Undersyde! Check out these places with a fresh coat of paint!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/2f71d6fa9dad1ca6000504ffbf5eda7ec8855397.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/c499dfb4973e06a748475c790a63681bb3df96b7.png[/img]

[h2]Other Changes![/h2]
[list]
[*]Overhauled Blackout Roke to be more interesting
[*]Blackout Roke is no longer a random event, and must be found manually
[*]A brand new hidden boss has been added, complete with a new achievement for beating it!
[*]New animations for Willie G.
[*]Allowed players to leave the Temple boss area, preventing softlocks
[*]Redone all water sprites
[*]Sped up water animation to be smoother
[*]Entrance of The Garden has been made more visually interesting
[*]Certain Parallax backgrounds have been redone and improved
[*]Tons of old miscellaneous tiles have been redone
[*]Greatly buffed chainsaw, but made it more expensive
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed areas where Nic could walk into the sky
[*]Fixed areas missing battle backgrounds
[*]Fixed a few areas where audio was too loud (This is still incomplete, if you find areas with poorly mixed audio, please let me know)
[/list]

[h2]On the topic of Mechana...[/h2]
For those of you looking forward to [b]DashBored 2: Mechana[/b], Development is moving forward smoothly. I don't have a crazy demo video to show off right now, but I've got a lot of really cool stuff that I can't wait to show off in the near future! Take a look at these screenshots! (Click to Enlarge)
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/ccb3db1e4842f4f3b1617875d53f80fa431e8014.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/583401a3c9d12a59d2aca1195241a10b61855f8a.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/271673e6ec133bac2ef99c7a8ea610e3d010b1a4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/7970da046ffabd77f30a4bca44d6b62ffc12002b.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/8006c359bb65f5478ce48c9109f75b6d7d30ec28.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/5d2aed992c12840b62140cfcb458f94c82919e8c.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/d56a80276fe8bf921609e78f0b0c8a99690f6b87.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/f98e5d710196ab393c5cd4c1f473ded01a80d83c.png[/img][/url]

I hope you all enjoy everything this update has to offer! I really gave it my all, and I'm very happy with the results.
As always, if you run into any bugs, or just have some feedback, feel free to let me know, I'm always happy to hear from you.

-Karbonic

notes.title: DashBored: Ancient Suffering is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/7d8189e42186167b2d604621c6ddca373f70bdc5.png[/img]
[h1]Happy Halloween from Fading Club Games![/h1]
I hope you've had a great spooky day, and what better to top it off than with a new Content update for DashBored!?

This is the first Major Content update since 2017! What a thing!
Let's take a look at those changes!

[h2]A Brand New Dungeon Appears in the Garden![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/6bbf987330db4402635b4b48edb531c92adc9989.gif[/img]
Deep in the darkest recesses of the Garden, a brand new Extra Secret Dungeon has appeared! Getting there in and of itself will be tricky, but just you wait until you see what the place has in store for you! This dungeon is the hardest yet in all of DashBored!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/afb6b63ec80f4d9de12637616d3e11005512ebc9.png[/img]
Perhaps this mysterious person could show you the way there...

[h2]Brand new intro![/h2]
The intro has been overhauled! Not only should it be more interesting to play, it should also help introduce the player to the world of DashBored in a more exciting way!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/fa867c9b780afdb217a1e68927ce887a1d295acb.png[/img]

[h2]New Enemies![/h2]
Four brand new enemies, including a new boss, have been added to the game! These enemies are especially devious, and only have plans to make you suffer!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/2a638dd1bfa803ba5f146913fb09a41abbbd6620.png[/img]

[h2]New Party Member![/h2]
For the first time in three years, a new party member has been added to the game!
Can you find this mysterious new pal and add them to your party? I doubt it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/d87ca8cb502697d6c7e373e4d5a1eebdb9093c1e.gif[/img]

[h2]Improved Face Sprites![/h2]
Many face sprites have been redone from the ground up, or redetailed to look a bit better. Just about every character has been touched up!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/ade10fb9b11eb35b4e92144a91fb79bcb3b08b28.png[/img]

[h2]Improved Cutscenes![/h2]
Many cutscenes have been given a fresh coat of paint!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/c164217853574cb9c99301399eab34b02503154b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/e5fda07eb2ef5abb6dec99311a694192f7075990.png[/img]

[h2]Improved Overworld Sprites![/h2]
More overworld sprites have been improved! Take a look at the Frog King's new style!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/7fed49ece09dff2acdc35228a1b34b3eeab4b680.png[/img]

[h2]Tileset Details Improved![/h2]
Many tilesets have gotten touch ups to really make them pop! Take a look at that difference!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/bab588feafde334d04c836d494ea17f7088655b2.png[/img]

[h2]New Achievements![/h2]
The new content comes with three new achievements! Try and get them all!

[h2]Other Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] All enemies now have elemental weaknesses and strengths, adding more depth to fights
[*] New armor items have been added
[*] Made the Frog King less likely to spam Double Shot, which could make the fight unwinnable
[*] Made some bosses a bit more challenging and complex in their fighting style
[*] New Animations for some old attacks
[*] Fixed a bug allowing you to talk to Nash forever
[*] Fixed a bug allowing you to go out of the boundaries in Precipice
[*] Cleaned up some cutscene graphics
[*] More stuff that I am probably forgetting
[/list]

I hope you'll enjoy this update to DashBored!
As always, thanks for playing!
Have something you want to say about this update or DashBored in general? Post in the comments! I always love hearing from you guys, and I'll do my best to respond as fast as possible!

Thanks!
-Karbonic

notes.title: DashBored Clean Up-Date now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/7e6447c08f9b0237bee2b0debd58dc2b04fa86d8.png[/img]
DashBored Clean Update is now available! The goal of this update is to clean up as many little problems as I could find. I hope you enjoy all of the improvements that come with this update!

[h1]Changes:[/h1]

[b]Redone NPC Overworld Sprites![/b]
A lot of the NPCs' overworld sprites have remained unchanged since 2016, and because of that, a lot of them were certainly starting to look a bit crusty. Almost all old NPC Sprites have been reworked! Either they have been completely redone from the ground up, or they have been retouched to look much better and to convey more personality than ever before! Here's a few examples!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/698a7f4ebea3a93cf86add0e4607f5a640470827.png[/img]
And many more have been updated! I hope you'll enjoy going through the game and meeting everyone with a new look!

[b]Completely Redone Dungeons![/b]
The caves leaving Undersyde were always a terribly designed waste of the player's time. Now they have been completely redone to have more engaging mechanics and brand new enemies!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/9574f71fad73177d04b7591f6067581980a0aa37.png[/img]

Likewise, the caves leading to the frog king have been expanded, and now hold their own brand new dangerous enemies!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/1ffcb7c493b15328fc24a2c42e32e2408deffe5a.png[/img]

[b]Unique Battlebacks![/b]
Certain areas now have uniquely drawn battle backgrounds! These should really set the mood!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/8999221bc8524cb830449d00cd059c9bc1bf7ed5.png[/img]

[b]Redone Mini-Boss Sprites[/b]
A few minibosses have recieved completely new sprites! These should give them more personality, and give them a bit of unique flair during their fights!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/878095b8cedcd49a600aabc8ba4ed226a68e22f9.png[/img]

[h2]Minor Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed Problem causing "Distressing Demigod" Achievement to be unachievable
[*]Fixed glitch allowing players to stand still and survive electric panels in satellite dungeon
[*]Made Electric Panels more forgiving, they now have a charge up time and more visually apparent graphics
[*]Fixed a problem causing the heat wave visual effect to not appear in Satellite Boiler
[*]Added visually notable and animated buttons to Vurrus door code puzzle
[*]Redone various cutscene graphics
[*]Redetailed various tilesets to make world graphics pop more in certain areas
[*]Redone Common Attack animations to be more visually interesting
[*]New Car Overworld Graphic
[*]Nic now appears smaller and moves slower on the main map
[*]Buffed Insult, now more likely to inflict 'Sad'
[*]Buffed Champion Shawl
[*]Added higher speed Debuff to Heavy Shawl
[*]Nicolas now starts with Violent Grab and learns Insult, rather than vice versa
[*]Added slight visual effect to underwater section of water treatment plant
[*]Fixed problem where Occidere would lead the group in the water treatment plant instead of Isaac
[*]Fixed issue causing two Midori and Jacks to appear in Day 3
[*]Extended various musical pieces into full tracks
[*]Fixed glitch where Nic could enter an empty house from the overworld
[*]Changed audio levels in various places to make the sound levels more uniform (Still needs work)
[*]Fixed Cutscenes still using old Nicolas sprites
[*]Redid town introduction logos to be more interesting and visually distinct
[*]Added boarders to overworld map, should now look more visually pleasing
[*]A new door has appeared in the world map of Day 3. What could it be? Only time will tell!
[/list]

Thank you for playing DashBored! It always means a lot to me to see people playing and discussing my work! I hope you enjoy playing this update, and the new content it brings to the table! I'm always open to hear feedback, so if you have any, just go ahead and shoot me a message! Have a great day!

Sincerely,
Karbonic

notes.title: DashBored: New Beauty Update Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/14b926e8eef314fa1c41acadb5b9cf3a68231633.png[/img]

Nearly two years since the last update to DashBored, I'm back at it again with another one! I can't stop myself!

[previewyoutube=EFdx5Ktj1iI;full][/previewyoutube]

Introducing DashBored: New Beauty!
The New Beauty update seeks to update various graphics which have aged poorly since the original release of the game.

[b]Major Changes[/b]
[u]Redone Character Battle Sprites[/u]
Most of the player battle sprites have remained unchanged since around the original release of the game. Because of that, they looked pretty ugly in retrospect. I've gone through and remade most of them from the ground up. Now, you can truly battle in style!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/27379e689f5b88858cb583b2d31a52164927a8ce.png[/img]

[u]Redetailed Enemy Battle Sprites[/u]
Like the player sprites, many sprites for enemies have remained absolutely unchanged since release. I've gone in and redetailed almost every single enemy sprite in the game, making them much more visually appealing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/12be94adb6c89beff6b1d98450a91bc5ace90852.png[/img]

[u]Redetailed Player overworld Sprites[/u]
I've cleaned up a few of the main character overworld sprites. These should help these older designed characters to mesh with the overworld.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/d5d1c792a1bafcf8bff8e3f69cdffd0ddd74d66f.png[/img]

[u]Redrawn Cutscene Graphics[/u]
Multiple cutscenes have had their graphics redone! I'll let you find them on your own, I think they're a huge improvement!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/659075cb14db83910378964572df9dfe1cf68038.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/7b8d72204ea04982f6e61030681cbe62189fdd2b.png[/img]

[b]Misc. Changes / Fixes[/b]
[list]

notes.title: DashBored Abduction Update Released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/7823eb19386a0e3530a69b69a511df751b09eed2.png[/img]

A new big update for DashBored has just been released, just in time for Halloween!

Something new has arrived in the Garden, its presence different than that of anything previously encountered...

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

[u]Redone Boss Sprites[/u]

I've gone and redid all of the old boss graphics to bring them up to par with the rest of DashBored's graphics. Along with this, some bosses have been tweaked to help balance and improve the battle gameplay.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/136f5b16077b138632ac015dca0c37fb2cf38cee.png[/img]

[u]New Cutscenes[/u]

A handful of new and improved cutscenes have been added to the game, to help add to the atmosphere of the game, including a brand new introduction cutscene for Vurrus! 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/a884f48befc2df14da49fdb8cde63d82cc7f61b7.png[/img]

[u]Improved Jack Moveset[/u]
Jack has had his moves tweaked and has been given a some new moves to help fill out his moveset and make him a more viable alternative to Midori.


[h1]New Content[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/08446be2544cb373d629d8b6b127e8fc89b0cee9.png[/img]
[u]New Ending Path[/u]
This is by far the biggest part of this update. A new pathway to unlock a brand new ending has been added! This path will be unlocked after beating the game and achieving the best ending. This new path will feature brand new bosses, events, and music! Find the answer to the biggest mystery the Garden has ever known! Lies! Deception! Intrigue! All will be found in the new ending of DashBored!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/08446be2544cb373d629d8b6b127e8fc89b0cee9.png[/img]

Other than all of that, a few minor tweaks have been added in certain areas like Roke and the hidden village to make them play a bit easier and look a bit easier on the eyes. I hope you will enjoy finding all of the new secrets this update has to offer!

[h1]Happy Halloween from Fading Club Games![/h1]

notes.title: DashBored: Justice Update Released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/59a8f6cef1601bcd3a4660afb0c8b75cb1791388.png[/img]

After all this time in development, the final update to DashBored is finally here!

[b]DashBored: Justice[/b] is by far the largest update made to DashBored. Yes, even bigger than the Halloween Update. Much, much bigger. I'm not kidding! Even I am slightly scared by its sheer size!

The improvements to the game are as follows:

[b]Brand new story path and Ending![/b]

The most important part of this update is the addition being made to the story of DashBored. Follow Nic and his degenerate friends as they go on their biggest adventure yet in a brand new branching story path!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/c48ddfced75bdcdce6183a6e869f93475a7c7f8e.png[/img]

[b]Six New Major Locations![/b]

The Garden just got a lot bigger! New optional dungeons! New Secret Areas! Game Shows! Can you find all that the Garden has to hold!?

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/1fba14517c7cf3bb4bb401d229352710022679bd.png[/img]

[b]Brand New Party Member![/b]

There's a new personality in the Garden, and it's a big one!
Can Nic convince them to join his cause before it's too late!?
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/ea56feba0f2274fbf27c97c0da6d15468c7a3feb.png[/img]

[b]45+ new music tracks![/b]

If you liked the OST of DashBored, you'll love the brand new songs that have been composed just for this update!

[b]30+ New Enemies![/b]
The Garden has gotten even more dangerous since you were here last. 
Battle it out with over 30 new Enemies and bosses made especially for this update!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/ea4ccfb5dc332a54f71b42ae02f0921b6e644f2c.png[/img]
[b]Some other improvements included in this update:[/b]

[list]
    [*]New Secret Events
    [*]Improved Battle Animations
    [*]Improved General Graphics
    [*]General Bug-fixes / Performance tweaks 
    [*]Much, much more that I'm forgetting about
[/list]

It's been a long road, but we are finally here. I sincerely thank you for playing DashBored, and I hope you will enjoy [b]DashBored: Justice[/b]!

-Finn "Karbonic" Tanguay

notes.title: HUGE Update Coming...
notes.content:
Hey guys, I know I haven't been all that active as of late. Sorry about that. I had problems in the family which had to be taken care of, but those seem to be over now.

I wanted to post this announcement to give a little sneak peek at what's to come.
Right now I am hard at work on a major update to DashBored.
This update will include:
-New and improved battle sprites
-Completely remade Coton (will make it more concise and easier to explore)
-Fixing a lot of glitches (thanks for bringing them to my attention)
-New scenes, areas, and encounters

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/d5543f41a2706b7b7b7b06acac283fa37ad6346d.png[/img]

I can't give an exact date for when this update will drop, but it should be in the coming weeks.

I'd like to apologize again for the recent inactivity, but things should be back on track from now on.

As soon as this update is up, I will begin on integrating a hard mode into DashBored.
